entities.title: The @utv/core package
entities.summary: @utv/core 0.3.0, an ES module whose one entry point is src/index.ts, compiled to dist/src/index.js with type declarations in dist/src/index.d.ts.
consumers: Application developers who import @utv/core in Node.js
The test suites under test/, which import ../src/index.js
guarantees: Everything public is exported from src/index.ts; modules are not imported one by one.
The package reads utv/1.0 values, writes utv-result/1.0 results and the text form utv-text/1; any other well-formed utv/M.N is unsupported, and a missing, non-string or malformed identifier invalid.
No runtime dependencies; typescript is the only devDependency.
Library code never reads the clock, the host's time zone or tz database, or its locale.
entities.compatibility: Versioned independently of the specification with Semantic Versioning (VERSIONING.md, Implementation versions), tagged typescript/vX.Y.Z. At 0.y.z SemVer allows any change in a minor version; CHANGELOG.md records each change, and every version so far is unreleased. The 0.2 JSON layer is kept unchanged beneath the 0.3 typed layer (docs/library-api.md §7).

entities.title: Typed API (0.3)
entities.summary: One immutable class per everyday value, Outcome<T> for partial operations, typed policies and TemporalContext, in TypeScript's idiom of docs/library-api.md.
consumers: The example suites under test/examples/, and test/typed.test.ts
guarantees: CivilDate, CivilYearMonth, CivilTime, CivilDateTime, FixedOffsetDateTime, ZonedIntent, Instant, Period, PosixSeconds, ElapsedSeconds and Interval<CivilDate | Instant> with Bound<T>; private constructors and static factories.
of throws a RangeError for a value that can't exist; tryOf, parse and fromJson return an Outcome and never throw for bad input.
Outcome<T> is a union of Unique, Multiple, None, Unsupported and Invalid discriminated on status, with assertNever, uniqueOr, single (throws OutcomeError), toString and toResult.
Total operations return plain values; addMonths(n, MonthEnd.Constrain) and addYears(n, MonthEnd.Constrain) are total, and passing another policy to them throws a RangeError.
compare, isBefore and isAfter exist only where the order is defined; ZonedIntent has none, and TemporalContext.compare answers Outcome<Ordering>.
toString is the text form, toJSON the UTV JSON (so JSON.stringify works), equals compares by representation; Node's inspector shows CivilDate(2026-11-05).
Policies are typed constants whose string literals type-check too: MonthEnd, Gap, Overlap, ResolutionPolicy (Strict, AllCandidates, of).
Years are bigint; numbers passed as integers must be safe integers.
entities.compatibility: The naming follows the TypeScript column of docs/library-api.md §6 (of, tryOf, parse, toJSON, fromJson, uniqueOr, single). See utv-core-package for versioning.

relationships.description: Every typed operation calls the JSON layer underneath.

entities.title: JSON layer (0.2) and validation (0.1)
entities.summary: Builders, parseIso, formatIso, parseText, formatText, fields, add, compare, daysBetween, posixSecondsBetween, contains, overlaps, resolve, toZone, toOffset, loadRules, the native adapters, and validateStructural and validateSemantic, on plain UTV JSON.
consumers: Application developers who work with UTV JSON directly
test/everyday.test.ts and test/text-form.test.ts, which run the shared fixtures through it
guarantees: Every operation returns a UtvResult (see implementations/typescript/src/.dev/contracts.json, utv-result-envelope) and never throws for a semantic outcome.
Outcomes and canonical shapes are those of conformance/operations/everyday.json and conformance/operations/text-form.json.
Rules are an argument: a ZoneRules, rule-bundle text or a parsed bundle.
Native adapters make the caller name the intent; "local" is refused with local-zone; conversions back report loss with precision-loss and zone-dropped warnings, or are unsupported.
parseStrict rejects duplicate keys; validateStructural checks all 26 kinds structurally; validateSemantic checks proleptic Gregorian civil values.
entities.compatibility: Kept unchanged from 0.3 on beneath the typed layer; diagnostic codes were renamed to the shared table in 0.3.0 (CHANGELOG.md). See utv-core-package for versioning.
